review_artifact.behavior_fixed: get_user_by_email now applies the existing normalize_email helper before querying storage. Email lookup therefore uses the same identity representation as creation and duplicate detection while preserving successful creation at HTTP 201, normalized duplicate rejection at HTTP 409, and missing-user responses at HTTP 404.
